2.t: and the night when it falls still

3.t: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺

4.t: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one

5.t: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased

6.t: Did He not find you as an orphan then sheltered you

7.t: Did He not find you unguided then guided you

8.t: And did He not find you needy then satisfied your needs

9.t: So do not oppress the orphan

11.t: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord
